• Note: This product does not include a battery

    【 Self-Rolling Interactive Cat Ball 】 This Interactive Cat Ball Has a Built-In Motor That Automatically Twists and Rolls Along Irregular Paths. It Stimulates a Cat's Instincts, Encouraging Them to Chase After It. Keep Your Indoor Cat Entertained and Active Even When You're Not Home.
  • 【 Realistic Plush Animals 】 Cute and Realistic Plush Animals (Available in Cute Rabbit and Mouse Designs) Are Encased in a Unique Transparent Shell. They Are Incredibly Cute and Skin-Friendly. Instantly Attracting Your Cat's Attention and Immersing Them in the Game Satisfies Their Curiosity While Keeping the Plush Clean and Intact.
  • 【 Intelligent Automatic Steering 】 No More Worries About Getting Stuck Under the Sofa! This Automatically Moving Cat Is Equipped with Intelligent Sensors That Automatically Change Direction When It Hits a Wall or Obstacle. Your Furry Friend Will Be Endlessly Entertained Chasing This Pet Ball.
  • 【 Durable and Sturdy 】 the Transparent Outer Ball Is Made of High-Quality, Sturdy Abs Material, Designed to Withstand Your Pet's Enthusiastic Scratching, Slapping, And Biting. It's Not Easily Damaged Even if Dropped, And the Smooth Surface Protects Your Cat's Claws and Teeth While Playing.
  • 【 Wide Application 】 This Self-Rolling Ball, Approximately 4.92 Inches in Diameter, Is Ideal for Energetic Kittens, Puppies, Adult Cats, And Small Pets to Pass the Time. Its Compact and Lightweight Design Makes It Easy to Carry and Store, Perfect for Home, Travel, And Outdoor Play, And Allows It to Move Freely on Its Own.
